mechanism_note: BlurAttribute with 1 iteration on a 4-connected grid computes blur(u)=(u_self+u_N+u_S+u_E+u_W)/5; therefore blur(u)-u = Laplacian/5 and D_EFF=D*5 recovers the physical diffusion term. FHN cubic kinetics u-u^3/3-v+I decomposed as three ShaderNodeMath(MULTIPLY) chains. Cross-field spiral initiation uses GeometryNodeSceneTime.Frame + FunctionNodeCompare + FunctionNodeBooleanMath(AND/OR) + GeometryNodeSwitch to gate two stimulus patches at specific frame ranges.
